title: Bedrock Ruins
description: Makes bedrock obtainable by mining bedrock ruins to craft tools
body:
Makes bedrock obtainable by mining bedrock ruins to craft tools
Bedrock is sli
## How does it work
1. Mine bedrock ruins which spawn near bedrock. Mining one ore will give 5 bedrock scraps
   ![Bedrock ruins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e8c04078d067da0940aceb7619c51b176b0b9782.png)
1. Make bedrock ingots using 5 bedrock scraps, 2 obsidian and 1 diamond block
   ![Bedrock ingot receipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2191fefd98a56c2ca97d78362acc6aae4894b1e3.png)
1. Craft bedrock tools the same way you would craft diamond ones, using bedrock ingots instead than diamonds
   
![Bedrock tools receipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f63283b13676c412c722ed83af267e9a49a858fd.png)
